title: Import
hint: Bring in CSS files from the server, upload a .css / .cssthema.zip, or manage the scripts (.js) your apps load.
localIntro: Hand-made .css files that nginx serves directly. Importing turns each file into a theme (v1) and then moves it to .geimporteerd/, so the same URL serves the theme. Folder:
filesCaption: Hand-made CSS files on the server
shadowsHint: A theme “{slug}” already exists: nginx serves this file instead of that theme. Move or remove the file on the server.
archiveNeedsPublish: Only live themes are archived: otherwise the URL would return 404.
uploadIntro: Upload a .css file (becomes a theme, the draft is its content), a .cssthema.zip bundle (theme with all versions, exported from cssthema) or a .js script (live right away at /<name>.js, see Scripts). A plain .zip with .css and .js files is unpacked first.
dropLimits: .css up to the server limit (512 KB by default) · .zip up to 25 MB · .js up to 512 KB
conflictNewVersion: New version of the existing theme
conflictNewVersionHint: Replaces the draft of the existing theme and adds a version.
conflictFailHint: Nothing is imported; you get an error.
publishAutoHint: .css: not published (draft only). Bundle: the live version from the bundle.
publishYesHint: The imported CSS (or the latest bundle version) goes live right away.
publishNoHint: Nothing goes live; publish later from the editor.
nameHint: Instead of the file name. For a .css it also sets the slug; for a bundle the slug comes from the bundle.
archiveHint: nginx then falls through to cssthema: the same URL serves the theme.
scriptNameLength: name: 2 to 64 letters, digits or hyphens
scriptOptions: Scripts are live right away at /<name>.js, without versions or a draft. If the name already exists, cssthema asks whether to replace it; the previous version goes to .scripts-archief/.
nameHintScript: Instead of the file name; becomes the URL /<name>.js.
resultScriptKeptText: A script {url} already exists; it was left alone.
scriptReplaced: {file} replaced; the previous version is in .scripts-archief/.
scriptGone: {file} is no longer in the folder (removed by hand?); the list has been updated.
copyFailed: Could not copy. The URL is {url}
scriptsIntro: Scripts (.js) in the same folder as the hand-made CSS. nginx serves them publicly at /<name>.js, without versions: an upload is live right away. Replacing and deleting move the previous version to .scripts-archief/ on the server.
scriptsEmptyText: Upload a .js, e.g. algemeen.js with the moving network background. It is then live at /algemeen.js right away; the snippet below loads it in an app.
scriptUnreadableHint: nginx cannot read this file, so {url} returns 403. On the server: chmod 0644 {path}
deleteScriptText: The file moves to {archive} on the server (it is not erased). {url} then returns 404: apps that load the script miss it until you upload it again.
scriptConflictText: {file} replaces the script at {url} and is live right away. The current version moves to {archive} on the server.
snippetIntro: Put this in Advanced of an app's proxy host: the theme and the script then go before </head> in every page. If Advanced already has a location /, put the lines in there. Note: this location replaces NPM's own. If the proxy host has an Access List (basic auth, allow/deny), it no longer applies here and the app is open: copy those lines from /data/nginx/proxy_host/<id>.conf into the location.
snippetCopyFailed: Could not copy; select the text and copy it yourself.
snippetCommentHead: cssthema: theme and script in every page (NPM → proxy host → Advanced)
snippetCommentAccessList: An Access List (basic auth, allow/deny) on this proxy host no longer applies here: copy its lines from /data/nginx/proxy_host/<id>.conf into this block
scriptWarningTitle: A script runs inside the app
scriptWarning: It has the same access as the app: sessions, cookies and everything you type. Only load scripts you trust yourself and do not inject them into password vaults (Vaultwarden, …) or other sensitive apps.
scriptErrorConflict: A script with this name already exists.
scriptErrorStateConflict: A folder or symbolic link has this name on the server; it is never overwritten.
scriptErrorName: This name cannot be used: 2 to 64 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
scriptErrorTooLarge: The script is larger than 512 KB.
scriptErrorContent: The file is empty, not UTF-8 or contains NUL characters.
scriptErrorStorage: The api cannot write to CSS_FILES_DIR. Check the owner and permissions of the folder on the server.
scriptErrorStorageWrite: The server could not write the file (disk full?).
zipEmpty: {file} is not a cssthema bundle and contains no .css or .js files.
zipErrorUnsupported: this browser cannot unpack zips; unpack it yourself
zipErrorNestedBundle: the bundle is inside a folder; zip that folder's contents, not the folder itself
